verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents API keys for authenticating requests on top of a master key. It also documents tenant tokens: short-lived, scoped credentials derived from an API key, with embedded filters that apply to every search, compared to Algolia secured keys or row-level security. That gives real least-privilege scoping for search access, which an agent could be issued. The evidence does not show API keys restricted by action or index, so write or indexing access for an agent cannot be shown to be least-privilege. Nothing ties scoped credentials to agent or MCP use. missing for 10: documented per-action/per-index API key permissions and expiry, guidance on scoped keys for agents/MCP clients, independent hands-on corroboration.
